tagline: Non-GxP field sales reporting app on PHP 5 + MySQL

profile.name: RepConnect
profile.business_function: Field force reporting for medical sales representatives: call logging, doctor visit plans and sample-drop tracking
profile.description: Custom-built web app used by sales reps to log HCP visits and generate weekly activity reports for regional managers. Not used for any GxP or patient data.
profile.tech_stack: PHP 5.6 with a home-grown MVC framework, jQuery, Bootstrap 3
profile.hosting: Single on-premises Linux VM (CentOS 6) with Apache; no load balancer; manual FTP deployments
profile.integrations: Monthly CSV export to the commercial data warehouse; email reports via local Postfix
profile.users: ~600 sales reps and 40 regional managers in India; heavy mobile browser usage
profile.data_classification: Business confidential; healthcare professional (HCP) contact details are personal data under the DPDP Act; no patient data; not GxP
profile.pain_points: Frequent outages, no mobile-friendly UI, no offline mode, the original developer has left, PHP 5.6 security vulnerabilities
profile.constraints: Budget is limited; the business wants a mobile-first experience within 2 quarters
